children: The Brand Leadership Showcase – IHCL, titled ‘Building India's Hospitality Legacy for the Next Century’, brought Suma Venkatesh, Executive VP - Real Estate & Development, Indian Hotels Company Ltd (IHCL)

The 10th edition of the prestigious BW Hotelier Indian Hospitality Summit & Awards (IHA 2026), hosted at the JW Marriott New Delhi Aerocity, is bringing leading voices from across the hospitality industry for the next two days of conversations on the sector’s growth and evolution. With the theme ‘India’s Hospitality Decade: From Growth to Greatness’, the Summit will examine the opportunities, challenges and shifts shaping India’s hospitality landscape as the industry enters a defining decade.

The Brand Leadership Showcase – IHCL, titled ‘Building India's Hospitality Legacy for the Next Century’, brought the company’s long-term development perspective into focus, exploring how India’s hospitality infrastructure and hotel landscape could evolve while building on an established legacy.

Suma Venkatesh, Executive VP - Real Estate & Development, Indian Hotels Company Ltd (IHCL), shared her perspective on the development opportunities shaping the Indian hospitality market and the considerations involved in building a portfolio for the future.

She outlined the company’s growth journey and its long-term strategy, tracing the evolution of its portfolio through the 2022 growth phase and the launch of Accelerate 2030 in November 2024. She highlighted how IHCL has moved beyond a focus on margins to expand its revenue portfolio, while maintaining confidence in India’s long-term growth story. Venkatesh also pointed to the changing nature of the Indian hospitality market, with customers increasingly seeking distinctive experiences and driving the evolution of the upscale and upper-upscale segments. The company’s growth has also been supported by a strong pipeline, with paper signings complemented by hotel openings.
“We are a company that has been in existence for more than a century. 2022 laid the new foundation of IHCL, and 2025 was a continuation of our 2022 growth,” said Venkatesh.
“In November 2024, we announced Accelerate 2030; we said we'll double our portfolio. We did not only focus on margins, we also doubled our revenue portfolios,” she added.

“Every customer is looking for unique experiences and that has led to the evolution of the market into Upscale and Upper Upscale segment in India. Our paper signings have been complemented well with hotel openings,” Venkatesh highlighted.

As the showcase drew to a close, the discussion focussed on IHCL's multi-brand ecosystem and disciplined growth framework. By balancing traditional luxury with rapid expansion into emerging markets and new hospitality formats, the company demonstrated how structured owner partnerships and continuous brand evolution will secure its dominant market position for the next century.

The two-day BW Hotelier Indian Hospitality Summit & Awards (IHA 2026) encompasses over 25 sessions where hospitality veterans and experts across the nation gathered to provide diverse knowledge and insights. The Summit & Awards is a testament to BW Hotelier’s commitment towards revolutionising Indian hospitality by honouring the crème de la crème of the industry.
